_comment: Hg T2 overlay B2F = CANDIDATE (2026-11-26; WORK_NOTES_hg_t2 section 23): R1B + depth-dependent evasion option B: hg_t2_ev_diff 1 (diffusion-reaction escape probability, CH4-module tortuosity hg_ev_tort 1, hg_ev_lref 0.3 m defaults), hg_t2_ev_diff_thaw 1 (thaw release 0.16 x P), hg_fd refit 0.215. Needs a binary with commit fb1d502c or later. R1B (hg_t2_overlay_R1B.json) stays the recommended baseline until adoption is decided. Scoring as R1B (src/reem/scoreR.py, 9 scored bands). model_settings overlay on top of the built-in hg_t2 preset and the MeHg preset; code defaults unchanged (all B switches off).
_site_keys: Per-site keys not in the overlay (set by the case): hg_dep_file (TVC / HPC: config/hg_deposition_{tvc,hpc}_geoschem.csv; Toolik: config/hg_deposition_toolik_obrist2017.csv), hg_sc_year0 (1850 spin-up stage / 1950 main, TVC / HPC). Run with dynamic_lai 1.
